crossRefs.note: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all…
I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us…
It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
